target_customer: C and C++ engineering teams in trading, embedded, automotive, silicon and systems software
problem: General coding agents work from source text and ignore build configuration, so changes often fail to compile or hide memory and threading bugs. C++ teams need agents that build, test and run sanitizers before review.
business_model: Free plan plus enterprise plan with on-prem and air-gapped deployment; bring your own model keys; prices not published
product_category: AI coding agent for C and C++

founders.name: Anirudha Kulkarni
education: IIT Delhi, B.Tech and M.Tech in computer science
previous_startups: LawSutra AI, co-founder and CEO (acquired by Manupatra)
founders.background_notes: Placed 3rd in India in the Jane Street Electronic Trading Challenge per the YC page.

founders.name: Pratyush Saini
previous_startups: LawSutra AI, co-founder and CTO (acquired by Manupatra)
founders.background_notes: Core engineer on NeuralDB and BOLT at ThirdAI per the YC page.

investors: Angel investors from quantitative trading firms

competitors.name: GitHub Copilot in VS Code
competitors.what: Agent mode with C++ symbol context and CMake build configuration awareness
competitors.traction_then: Large existing user base across VS Code

technical_complexity.rationale: Must read real build configuration, run compilers and sanitizers, and verify tests per change across many toolchains, including air-gapped deployments. Hard to do well for C++ build systems.

defensibility.rationale: Build-aware verification loops are copyable by general agents, as Copilot's February 2026 C++ update and community Claude Code and Codex workflows show. C++ depth and trust of core contributors are the differentiators.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Microsoft added C++ build awareness in Feb 2026; Claude Code and Codex have community C++ and sanitizer workflows. No acquisition of ByteAsk found.

market_need_then: C++ remains central in trading, embedded and systems code, and teams there are strict on correctness and data privacy. Founders came from trading firms and spoke at CppCon per the YC page.

identity.voice_and_tone: Technical and direct; headline 'Your AI C++ Engineer'

branding.brand_signature: Every change arrives compiled, sanitized and tested
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launch and a funding story syndicated across Indian startup outlets; the site lists open source projects whose core contributors use it

brand_strength.rationale: Name is generic and easy to confuse with ByteDance, but the C++ positioning is clear and the launch press was wide.

outcome_analysis: Active and very early. The founders already built and sold LawSutra AI to Manupatra, came from trading and infrastructure engineering, and raised a YC and Entrepreneur First led pre-seed in September 2026. The main risk is that Copilot, Claude Code and Codex add build-aware C++ workflows, narrowing the niche.
